replicaCount.description: Pinned to 1: migrations run in an init container, so multiple replicas race the migration lock and all but one show Init:Error on a fresh install.

autoCreateTenants.description: This development chart registers active tenants on their first request.

expectedPods.description: NOAH_EXPECTED_NUMBER_OF_PODS. Sources disagree on whether this counts Noah server pods or indexer replicas; see values.yaml.

cacheWarmScaleInTimeout.description: A positive duration such as 30s, 5m or 1h that enables cache-warm scale-in behavior.

tenantConfig.description: Optional per-tenant configuration written to data/config.yaml.
